title: Are Prediction Markets the Future of Finance? | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
summary: Are prediction markets harmless, or a dangerous gateway to gambling? Jill, Mark and special guest Kayla Sabbagh explore why younger generations are increasingly betting on everything—and what risks come with these easy-to-access platforms. Plus, a 29-year-old homeowner wants to know how to put her newfound financial security to work.
